item.tib: tshe dbang thugs bcud bder gshegs stong gi cho ga u dum wa ra'i phreng ba'i dbang khrid byin rlabs char rgyan
item.coloph: zhes bder gshegs stong gi dbang chog 'di bzhin dgos zhes khro chen nang so rin po che'i bka' dang / dbu bla rnam gsum gtsos pa'i bka' 'bang slob ma'i tshogs kyis bskul ngor lcags pho 'brug lor rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i bklag lung gnang skabs gter ston byang chub rig rtsal gling pa nyid kyi zhal snga nas rtsom gzhi gnang ba la gzhi byas nas/ nyag smad khod spungs blo gros thogs med kyi gdung las dal rten rnyed pa'i gshen gyi drang srong ngag dbang skal bzang rgyal mtshan nas gter gzhung gi zhabs 'degs su sbyar te nye bar bris pa zab gter gyi bstan pa phyogs kun tu khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
